hazards.control: Eye and skin protection at the cementing unit; dust controls at bulk transfer.
Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Cementing unit and bulk equipment
function: The pump truck that mixes and pumps the slurry, with the bulk cement transports and the batch mixer or recirculating mixer that feeds it.

tabs.overview: Dry cement and additives are blended in bulk, mixed with water at the unit to the design density, and pumped down the casing at the planned rate; displacement follows with mud or water. Density and rate are recorded through the job.
tabs.engineering: Pump pressure for the job; densitometer control; slurry tests per API 10A before the job.
tabs.connections: Bulk to mixer to pump to the cement head.
tabs.safety: Cement dust and caustic slurry; high-pressure lines.
tabs.evidence: API Spec 5CT (S27), API Spec 10A (S28), API RP 10D-2 (S30), field practice (S9). Sizes are public nominal values; the schematic depth is not to scale.
tabs.operations: Once per string; results feed the cement evaluation.
tabs.failure_modes: Density off target, pump failures, early set.
